title: Why Choose Factory-Authorized Repairs for Your Jaguar or Land Rover
excerpt: Learn about the importance of factory-authorized repairs and how they protect your vehicle's value and warranty.
body:
When it comes to repairing your Jaguar or Land Rover, choosing a factory-authorized repairer isn't just about quality — it's about protecting your investment.

What Does Factory-Authorized Mean?

A factory-authorized repairer has been certified by the vehicle manufacturer to carry out structural and cosmetic repairs to their exact specifications. This means access to genuine parts, manufacturer-approved repair methods, and technicians trained specifically for your vehicle.

Why It Matters

Using a non-authorized repairer can void your warranty, reduce your vehicle's resale value, and potentially compromise its structural integrity. Modern European vehicles use advanced materials — aluminium, high-strength steel, carbon fibre — that require specialized equipment and training to repair correctly.

Eurotech's Authorization

Eurotech is New Zealand's only factory-authorized Jaguar and Land Rover structural repairer. This means we have direct access to manufacturer repair specifications, genuine parts supply chains, and ongoing training from Jaguar Land Rover.

Every repair we complete comes with the confidence that your vehicle has been restored to its original factory specification.
